customSections.label: KCS Half-Days and Dismissal Times
customSections.content: KCS has seven student half-days in 2026–27. Elementary schools generally dismiss at 11:15 a.m., middle schools at noon and most high schools at noon. Career Magnet Academy and L&N STEM Academy dismiss at 1 p.m.; preschool schedules and other exceptions vary by program. Check the official School Schedules page for your child's school.

customSections.label: How to Read the KCS Calendar
customSections.content: KCS lists 180 instructional days, defined as 177 student instructional days plus three days accumulated under the daily seven-hour schedule. That does not mean students attend 180 full school days: seven scheduled student days are half-days, and the calendar also marks staff workdays when students do not attend.

customSections.label: Weather Closures and Makeup Days
customSections.content: KCS may cancel up to eight instructional days because of inclement weather or serious outbreaks of illness before makeup days are required. When an early-morning closure or delay is necessary, the district says it tries to decide before 5 a.m. and then notifies families through its phone system, websites, social channels and regional news media.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school for KCS students in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day for KCS students is Monday, August 10, 2026, and it is a half-day. Sixth- and ninth-grade orientation takes place August 7, but that is not the first day for all students.

calendarFaqs.q: When do KCS students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: KCS students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. Winter Break ends January 1, but January 4 is a staff in-service and administrative day with no school for students.

calendarFaqs.q: What time do KCS schools dismiss on half-days?
calendarFaqs.a: Elementary schools generally dismiss at 11:15 a.m., middle schools at noon and most high schools at noon. Career Magnet Academy and L&N STEM Academy dismiss at 1 p.m. Preschool and other school-specific exceptions appear on the official KCS School Schedules page.

calendarFaqs.q: Does KCS have 180 full student days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: No. KCS defines its 180 instructional-day total as 177 student instructional days plus three days accumulated under the daily seven-hour schedule. Seven scheduled student days are also half-days.

calendarFaqs.q: Which KCS in-service days are no-school days for students?
calendarFaqs.a: Students do not attend on November 3, February 15 or April 7; KCS marks each as a systemwide in-service day and student holiday. January 4 is also student-free because staff have a half-day in-service and half-day administrative workday.

calendarFaqs.q: How many weather days can KCS use before makeup days are required?
calendarFaqs.a: The KCS calendar allows up to eight instructional-day cancellations for inclement weather or serious illness outbreaks before makeup days are required. If KCS changes the schedule, the district's latest announcement takes precedence.
